entry_state: Option protection cost follows transaction or time-period treatment,with actual and aligned components separately valued. A purchased call's cumulative-loss selector does not cover every signed collar. A matched zero-cost collar retains separate gross contracts and signed interim reserves,while terminal cost is clipped between its strikes. Forward-component treatment requires an explicit election. Rebalancing preserves old gains and layer origins;repeated additions never restart the cumulative lower-of calculation. Added and removed instruments remain the next dependency.
exit_state: An acquired derivative's price is an asset origin,not a hedge gain. Instrument reductions preserve gains earned while designated and leave the hedged purchase unchanged;later undesignated changes enter profit. Matched purchase-portion cessation freezes a reserve whose release depends on expectation and loss recovery. Different designation prices defeat nominal-percentage allocation. The origin-matched derivation separates continuing reserve,frozen reserve and post-cessation gains;its terminal inventory bridge continues after page216. A false backward reference on213 is queued as RR346-007.
